$comment: Offerte OFF-2026-0042 for Bakkerij De Graaf as PqOfferte draws it: its contact is the bakery's owner Kees Bakker (his role in part 68), it expires 30 days out (the board's 6 November from 7 October), and its history has three moments by Pieter Jansen: made from the lead as version 1 (subtotal 3720), 10% off the hosting (3678) and the own line for the till link (4428). The contact and expiry are changes because the bakery's contact is declared in a later part; the history entries carry the subtotal each step left. The quote's Voorbeeld pdf names filinq's Offerte template by its slug "offerte" in record_document_templates; resolving a slug there needs pipelinq's FilinqLetterAdapter to look slugs up in its namespace (filinq's TemplateSlugResolver), as it takes only an id today. Contract CON-2026-0031 names Joke Smit as its contact (salesContract 1.1.0 contactRef), set here because part 68 declares her after the contract's part 43; her Gerelateerd card on PqContactpersoon then lists it.
